decisions.scenario: Choosing Cambridge Lodge Restaurant and providing Sunday reservation details

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hello. I'd like some information about a restaurant.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. Do you have a preferred price range or type of food?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: An expensive restaurant would be fine.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are several expensive options. Do you have a cuisine preference?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No. I'm just looking for a good local restaurant.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I recommend Cambridge Lodge Restaurant in the west. Would you like to make a reservation?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please. I'd also like a reference number.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: What date and time would you like, and how many people will be attending?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like a table for two people at 17:45 on Sunday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thanks. I have the reservation details for Cambridge Lodge Restaurant: two people at 17:45 on Sunday.
